items.source: Configuration class used to set up a RedisConnection with RedisConnectionFactory for connecting to Redis Sentinel(s).
items.translation: 用于通过RedisConnectionFactory配置与Redis Sentinel(s)连接的RedisConnection的Configuration类。

items.source: Configuration class used to set up a RedisConnection via RedisConnectionFactory for connecting to Redis Cluster.
items.translation: 用于通过 RedisConnectionFactory 配置 RedisConnection，以连接到Redis 集群的配置类。

items.source: Configuration class used for setting up RedisConnection via RedisConnectionFactory connecting to single Redis using a local unix domain socket.
items.translation: 用于通过RedisConnectionFactory配置单台使用本地 Unix 域套接字连接的RedisConnection的配置类。

items.source: Configuration class used to set up a RedisConnection with RedisConnectionFactory for connecting to a single node Redis instance.
items.translation: 用于配置RedisConnection和RedisConnectionFactory的类，以便连接到单个节点Redis实例。

items.source: Configuration class used for setting up RedisConnection via RedisConnectionFactory using the provided Master / Replica configuration to nodes know to not change address.
items.translation: 用于通过提供的RedisConnectionFactory接口配置RedisConnection接口的配置类，该配置将主从节点地址固定，防止其发生变化。

items.source: RedisConfiguration part suitable for configurations that may use authentication when connecting.
items.translation: 适用于连接时可能需要身份验证的 RedisConfiguration 部分。

items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。

items.source: Configuration interface suitable for Redis cluster environments.
items.translation: 适用于 Redis 集群环境的配置界面。

items.source: Configuration interface suitable for single node redis connections using local unix domain socket.
items.translation: 适用于使用本地 Unix 域套接字连接单个节点 Redis 的配置界面。

items.source: Configuration interface suitable for Redis Sentinel environments.
items.translation: 适用于 Redis Sentinel 环境的配置界面。

items.source: Configuration interface suitable for Redis master/replica environments with fixed hosts.
items.translation: 适用于固定主从节点的 Redis 主从环境配置界面。
RedisConfiguration.WithAuthentication 在 org.springframework.data.redis.connection 中的用途
